exception_semantics.already_in_debug: Redirect through the pinned debug-exception route without overwriting machine exception context or re-saving debug-entry context.
exception_semantics.outside_debug: Retain pinned normal trap redirect and machine exception context updates.
exception_semantics.exception_classes: The contract applies across supported synchronous exception causes; it is not limited to one opcode or cause.
exception_semantics.ebreak: Preserve the pinned special handling inside and outside Debug Mode.
exception_semantics.interrupts: Preserve pinned interrupt/NMI masking, entry, and restoration behavior outside the stated synchronous exception defect.

preservation_requirements: Preserve both editable module signatures and every pinned legal parameter configuration.
Preserve debug entry, debug exit, EBREAK, normal exception, interrupt, NMI, MRET, CSR, PMP, performance-counter, fetch, LSU, and pipeline behavior outside the repair.
Preserve upstream copyright and license headers.
Do not modify read-only projection files or add, delete, rename, or symlink files.
